notes.title: MULTIPLAYER BETA TEST OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/54bfGcJ.gif[/img]

[b]
💎 Gem Collection Battle 💎 has won the public vote and the first gamemode will be played around a PvP battle to gain the most gems. This is the first Multiplayer public beta test and is not representative of the final game, please be aware there are many bugs and issues, and gameplay will not work exactly as intended.

There are no current objectives as of yet, this is a general test to find more bugs or issues that may come up. You are able to Grow your Marble based on how many Gems you collect, and other players are able to push you off with powerups on the new Multiplayer Map! Thank you and I can't wait to see you all in game!

[h1]Current Features[/h1]
- 4 Player multiplayer
- Host your own server, or join someone else's to play
- Gem Collecting and Marble Growth
- All powerups useable except Gravity
- Chat to other players(Enter)

[h1]Known issues[/h1]
- No player name tags
- Only the server host has a name in chat
- No pause menu, you must use "/q" chat command or ALT+F4 to quit
- General sync issues
- Marble speed will vary when picking up gems
- Server list always shows servers as "Creating" and "9,999 ping"
- All other players have the same skin
- Currently Windows systems only(trying to get Linux build asap)

[h1]Planned Updates[/h1]
- Unlock 4 player limit
- 5-10 minute rounds to determine the winning player
- Ways to steal Gems from the bigger player Marbles
- More powerups
- Map rotation


[h1]Join Discord for Updates & Report Bugs![/h1]
[url=https://discord.gg/marbleskies]https://discord.gg/marbleskies[/url]

notes.title: VOTE FOR MULTIPLAYER MODE!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31146653/f90c6b4713588c6f657d42b06db85a7fb0cb2f74.png[/img]

[b]A basic multiplayer [u]BETA[/u] update will soon be out for stress and cross-platform testing, and we need your help to decide its future. We have toyed with a couple of different ideas, but it's come down to choosing between either traditional(Marble Blast style) gem collecting or a Tag/Zombie Infection game mode. [/b]

💎 [b]Gem Collection Battle[/b] 💎
- Collect Gems to earn points
- 3 Gem colours, each give different amount of points
- Gems randomly spawn every 20 - 30 seconds
- Each time you collect a gem, your marble grows in size, and slows in speed slightly
- Whoever has the most points in 5-10 minutes wins the round

🧟 [b]Zombie Infection/Tag[/b] 🧟
- 1 random player spawns as a Green Zombie Marble
- Zombie player is a Big Marble, and moves slightly slower than normal
- Each time the Zombie touches another player, they are infected
- The infection spreads until there is only 1 player left
- Last player alive wins

[b]Please let us know in the comments below, or join us on Discord at [url=https://discord.gg/marbleskies]https://discord.gg/marbleskies[/url][/b]

notes.title: REPLAY REWORK!

[h1]Replays have been re-worked, and will load specific Medal replays for the time that you currently need to beat![/h1]

[b]Previously, any replay that was loaded would be the most up-to-date level record. This meant that new/casual players would only see a very hard to beat Replay of a level.

Now; If you have a Bronze Medal, a Silver level replay will load, and if you have a Silver Medal, a Gold level replay will load and so on until you are good enough to challenge the World Record!

We hope this update encourages some more of the casual players to try go for Silver/Gold medals, without being overwhelmed by record holders![/b]

[i]Note: No update to download required as it was all changed server-side![/i]

notes.notes:
0.06-RC3 will be out for testing within the hour! Over the past few weeks we have been working on major database upgrades, a marble skin store, and aditional ranking leaderboards for players to compete globally. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31146653/f19a30969310e470e044bb0a10cadd52d1fda191.jpg[/img]

[h1]Behind the scenes database upgrades[/h1]
We are now tracking a variety of user stats which will be accesible in the Extras Leaderboards menu. Global Rank, Level, Gems, Distance and Deaths can be compared with other users. 

Please be aware that this is the first live test of the new database systems, and you may run into issues. We apologize for any inconveniences, and ask you submit any bug reports to our Steam Community Forums.

[h1]- How do Global Ranks work?[/h1]

Your global rank is calculated based on your skill level and how much you play the game. Everyone will start from 0, it will be quick to climb up the ranks if you are committed enough, but also not too discouraging for newer players who start at a skill disadvantage.

[h1]- Marble Store/Skin Roster[/h1]
Playing the game will reward you with Gems to spend in the Skin Store. Each day 8 different skins will be up for sale in the store. You can earn gems by leveling up and completing levels.

There are 58 skins total; common, uncommon and rare. Each day the roster will feature 4 commons, 3 uncommons and 1 rare skin, all with different prices. 

Once you have bought these skins they can be accessed and applied at anytime in the Inventory menu. Can you collect them all?


[h1]- Server upgrades[/h1]
You should never have any downtime which was a rare issue before.

A long with this, times and stats will never be lost again as the new systems allow complete control and flexability. With this comes increases to cheat-detection, we can now properly ban offending users from competing in any of the leaderboards!

[h1]- Two New Levels![/h1]

We are now at 82 total levels! 22 more since the first release! Extended Bunny and Rolling Hills can be found in the Bonus stage selection screen.

[h1]PATCH NOTES v0.06-RC1 - 01/27/2018[/h1]

This is our first release candidate update for public beta testing of the new physics system.

[b]Whats New[/b]:

- Physics improvements

Don't worry about your already completed times! This new physics system is exactly the same as the old, but should fix major "bounce glitch" issues. 

- 2 New User Levels

Gemsweeper by Jazzek & Courage by le mems


[b]What does RC mean?[/b]

We originally planned to have a whole new global ranking system in the v0.05 update, but because of issues that came up It was post-poned. notes.title: Marble Skies is Coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello Steam!

We are finally glad to announce that the game we have been working on for the past year has been accepted on to Steam!

Marble Skies is heavily inspired by Marble Blast, but we do intend to create much more features in the future over the traditional ball rolling style of game-play. After release, along with the game, and 60 levels of various difficulty, we plan to have weekly updates with new levels, and features.


In the coming month or so until the game is released, we would like to show you as much as we can about the game, and also are looking for as much community feedback as possible. 

Community feedback is very important to us, whether you have a suggestion, or complaint, we will try to respond to you as much as we can.
